blog.title: Is your roof ready for solar? 7 checks before your site survey
blog.description: Seven simple checks on shade, space, roof strength, electricity connection and paperwork that tell you if your Aligarh home is ready for rooftop solar.
blog.body:
Most homes in Aligarh and Western UP can take rooftop solar, but a few simple checks decide how big the system can be and how much it will save. Do these seven checks before our engineer visits and the survey takes half the time.

## 1. Shade between 9 am and 4 pm

Solar panels produce most between 9 am and 4 pm. Walk onto your roof at mid-morning and mid-afternoon and look for shadows from water tanks, a taller neighbouring house, trees or a mobile tower. A small shadow on one panel lowers the output of the whole string, so tell the surveyor about anything that casts shade at any time of year.

## 2. Free roof space

As a rough guide, every 1 kW of solar needs about 100 sq ft of shadow-free roof. A 3 kW home system needs about 300 sq ft. Count only the open area, not the space under the water tank or the staircase room.

## 3. Roof type and strength

- **RCC (concrete) roof:** the best base; panels sit on a raised steel structure.
- **Tin or asbestos sheet roof:** possible with a different mounting, common on shops and factories.
- **Old or leaking roof:** get the repair done before installation, because panels stay for 25 years.

## 4. Electricity connection in your name

For the PM Surya Ghar subsidy the electricity connection must be in the name of the house owner, and the bill should be up to date. Keep your latest bill ready: the consumer number on it is used for the online application.

## 5. Your monthly units

Look at the units (kWh) on your last 6 to 12 bills, not only the amount. The system size is worked out from your units. You can get a quick estimate with our [solar calculator](/calculator).

## 6. Sanctioned load

Your bill also shows the sanctioned load in kW. If the solar system will be larger than this, the load may need to be increased with your DISCOM. We check this during the survey.

## 7. Documents for the subsidy

For a home system under PM Surya Ghar, keep these ready:

- Latest electricity bill
- Aadhaar card of the connection holder
- Bank account details (passbook or cancelled cheque) for the subsidy credit
- Proof of house ownership, or the owner's consent if the house is jointly owned

The central PM Surya Ghar subsidy for homes is up to Rs 78,000, and Uttar Pradesh adds up to Rs 30,000 through UPNEDA. Both are credited to your bank account after installation and inspection. Commercial and industrial buildings are not covered by this subsidy.

## Book a free site survey

Greenedge Infratech is a registered vendor under PM Surya Ghar in Uttar Pradesh. Our engineer checks shade, roof space, structure and load, and gives you a written quotation. [Book a free site survey](/contact) or call +91 98370 67681.
